bounds.inputTokenUpper: First call: UTF-8 request bytes plus 8192 framing. Later calls: provider-reported input token count for an exactly unchanged input prefix, plus all appended-item and changed-field UTF-8 bytes, plus 8192 framing. Unknown usage retains the full reservation.
bounds.unknownUsage: Retain pre-call reservation; unknown HTTP outcome consumes full remaining allowance without retry

method: Existing staging UI and server credentials. Optional header lowers limits, does not grant QA quota privilege. All requests sequential; each later test receives remaining total USD allowance. No new credentials.
